answer: A harbor of trust forms when every agent must stake a refundable deposit before trading: the deposit is slashed if the agent is caught faking work, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand deposits. Like a zephyr that only whispers through open doors, reputation then flows only along proven payment history - a new identity starts with zero trust and must earn it slowly, making a Sybil flood expensive and slow while honest agents keep trading.
